newsitem.title: USA: Broaddus says CPI good measure of U.S. inflation.
newsitem.headline: Broaddus says CPI good measure of U.S. inflation.

text.p: Richmond Federal Reserve Bank President Alfred Broaddus on Friday said that on balance the Consumer Price Index was a good measure of inflation and that the Fed can allow for the bias in determining policy.
He told reporters following remarks to a teachers' group, that the Fed knew the "nature of the bias, something about the magnitude and its direction, so that we can correct for that."
He added that the CPI as "a general measure of inflation is a very good one."
But he said that he personally focused a good deal of attention on the core CPI rate, which excludes the volatile food and energy sector.
